index.guide.intro:
You have started your TouchFish journey {count} time(s).
We recommend viewing the introduction before first use.
You can also open the guide from Settings later.
This screen will not appear after 5 uses.
index.guide.warning:
Please note that you should NEVER add any environment variables that begin with TOUCHFISHUR2 before running this program, as this could lead to the leakage of your account/password.
If you don't understand "environment variables", please DO NOT open this application except through the Start Menu/desktop shortcut.
